body:
The platform extends the existing floral renderer with a shared Lua core for versioned pattern contracts, deterministic recipes, structural validation, document views, and PDF/SVG output. The public CLI supports validation, generation, replay, diagnostics, and bounded failures across the implemented providers.

Stages 00–30 have passed. The common LuaLaTeX and XeLaTeX adapters share semantic assets, physical page and spread placement, protected content, searchable lettering, dependency invalidation, and bounded auxiliary convergence. Acceptance verified both native book consumers, physical placement, vector/text/paint comparisons, intentional failures, legacy exports, and the extracted source kit. [Stage 30 accepted native CI](https://github.com/UPerna/florilegium/actions/runs/42198761489)

Stage 31 is in progress. A pinned Lua/Wasm runtime runs the actual shared core in a dedicated browser worker, with bounded messages and execution, cancellation, stale-result protection, offline execution, and an immutable local cache. Real desktop Edge checks cover all 22 families and exact instance replay, plus 32 adversarial/conformance checks. Two libm-sensitive families use an independent structural and tightly bounded numerical comparison; the other native comparisons are byte exact. Cache saves capture private byte and metadata snapshots before asynchronous validation, including a caller-mutation regression. The candidate's complete native and Linux browser checks are pending. [Current stage 31 CI](https://github.com/UPerna/florilegium/actions/runs/42216668040)

Stages 32–39, including the editor, final quality review, packaging, and publication, remain pending. This PR stays a draft until the mandatory gates pass. Current execution records are in docs/project/STATUS.md and STAGES.json; stage receipts retain source and verification evidence. No deployment or release has occurred.

Stage 00 used the user-approved verified GitHub replacement baseline because the original delivery was lost. It does not claim recovery of the missing original commit.
